newsitem.title: UK: HK stocks in London fall after Intel warning.
newsitem.headline: HK stocks in London fall after Intel warning.

text.p: LONDON, May 30 - Hong Kong stocks in London were dragged lower on Friday following a profits warning by U.S. chip bellwether Intel Corp which sent a shudder through equity markets in Europe and North America, dealers said.
Intel said its second-quarter profits would disappoint with demand in Europe being lower-than-projected.
The Hang Seng London Reference Index dropped 104.80 points to close at 14,653.01 after the Hang Seng Index in Hong Kong soared 341.24 points to close at 14,757.81, an all-time high.
"There has been a general mark-down following the Intel warning," said one dealer.
"There is not much selling but marketmakers don't want to get hit at these levels after the recent rise," he added.
Heavyweight banking group HSBC Holdings was a casualty falling HK$3.5 to HK$231.5.
